objections.about: The customer asked what is wrong with their body, but the reply never names the problem; the error points at body/template/id, and the reply does not say whether the tmpl_quote_card value or the templateId field name is the issue.

The reply tells the customer to switch to the templateId and inputs format and the from-templates endpoint, but the customer already sent templateId and inputs to /v2/videos/creations, so the instruction repeats what they already did and rests on an unverified diagnosis of an older Create Visual format.
